title: Don Juan, or If Don Juan Were a Woman
writer: Jean Cau, Roger Vadim, Jean-Pierre Petrolacci
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Robert Hossein, Mathieu Carrière
plot: A modern-day Don Juan-styled woman, who prides herself in the destruction of men who have fallen for her charms, reveals to a priest the murder she has committed and honestly details her past sexual encounters.
